messages:
Nina (Product): Quick heads-up: we're running a controlled preview of the new Quartz micro-pools (H200p-Nano) in Lagos (ng-1) and Helsinki (fi-1) next week. Target start: 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. Pools are optimized for short, latency-sensitive inference (<100ms tail) and light memory models.
Raj (Cloud Ops): Sweet. What are pool sizes and reservation options?
Nina (Product): Each region will have 6x 1-GPU nano nodes and 3x 2-GPU nodes. Reservation durations: 30m, 2h, 8h. We'll expose a "quartz-nano" pool label.
deploy-bot: Fleet image v3.8.2 deployed to ng-1 and fi-1. Kernel patch KP-2026-03-17 applied.
Leah (SRE): Any routing changes? Will requests auto-fallback to nearby H200p/RTX families?
Nina (Product): Routing rule: if request includes pool_hint=quartz-nano it prefers this pool. Otherwise autoscale and routing will avoid quartz for heavy batch workloads. Fallback permitted to h200p-standard or rtx-micro with a warning event.
Raj (Cloud Ops): Policy note: To prevent noisy-neighbor issues, we enable per-org nano_quota: 2 concurrent nano reservations by default. Superusers can request quota raise via the internal form. Also preemptible flag allowed for 30m slots only.
Tom (Sales): Can we give a couple of startup beta customers access? They want Helsinki for EU latency tests.
Nina (Product): Yes — please file a support request with tag "beta-quartz". We'll whitelist up to 5 orgs across both regions during the first 72h.
Raj (Cloud Ops): CLI reservation example:
```
redwood reserve --pool quartz-nano --region fi-1 --duration 30m --label quartz-beta --project ml-realtime
```
Reminder: --project is required for billing during preview.
deploy-bot: Billing ledger "preview-quartz" created. All reservations with label quartz-beta will be billed to preview-quartz.
Leah (SRE): Monitoring additions: please subscribe to metrics refinery.quartz.gpu.util and refinery.quartz.latency_p95. I'll add an alert when p95 > 120ms for 3m.
Raj (Cloud Ops): Also: thermal mitigation turned on by default. If GPU temp > 85C we'll auto-throttle and emit an event.
Tom (Sales): Noted. I'll coordinate with customers and advise about the 2-concurrent limit. Anything for legal/compliance?
Nina (Product): No special compliance requirements for preview. We will not accept regulated data in quartz-nano during this phase. Ops will enforce a policy block.
deploy-bot: Audit log created: audit/preview-quartz/2812345678. Reservation events and fallback triggers will be recorded.
Leah (SRE): I'll spin up a rotation for the first 48h and run chaos tests (network partition + node reboot) during the first maintenance window.
Raj (Cloud Ops): Post-launch checklist: node health probes verified (done), billing tags enforced (done), docs draft in progress at https://redwood.internal/docs/quartz-nano-preview.
Nina (Product): Thanks everyone — official public announcement scheduled after whitelist phase. If you want early access, submit the support case before 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC. :sparkles:
